meta.description: Single source of truth for finding status. Statuses are verified against live code at auditedSha, NOT copied from the dated report prose. See audit-reports/README.md.
meta.idAlgorithm: id = 'LL-' + sha256(ruleKey + '|' + path) first 10 hex chars; stable across runs so recurrence is a diff
meta.governance: Only Scot closes a finding, downgrades severity, or accepts risk. closureEvidence.attestation stays empty until Scot signs. No student/patient data ever appears here; evidence snippets are code only.
meta.remediationSLA: critical 24-72h, high 15-30d, medium 60d, low 90d (advisory; from plan section 1.1)

findings.title: SQL injection via unwhitelisted sort_by in licenses endpoint

evidence.snippet: allowed_sort_columns = %w[id status seat_type granted_at expires_at created_at].freeze

remediation.options: Allowlist sort_by against a fixed column set before interpolation into .order().

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: licenses action now guards sort_by via allowed_sort_columns allowlist (organizations_controller.rb:221-225); only the validated value reaches .order(). sort_order already validated against asc/desc.

findings.notes: April seed showed this as a live P0; remediated since.

findings.title: License records not deleted by GDPR flusher (Right to Erasure gap)

remediation.options: Nullify user_id/granted_at and flush versions for License in flush_user_content.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: flush_user_content now iterates License.where(user_id:) nullifying user_id+granted_at and calling flush_versions (flusher.rb:224-226).

findings.title: No AuditEvent on license claim/release (FERPA access-log gap)

remediation.options: Log AuditEvent in claim_user controller action and License#release_user!.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: claim_user logs AuditEvent.log_command (organizations_controller.rb:238); License#release_user! logs AuditEvent.log_command('system', ...) (license.rb:32).

findings.title: No AuditEvent on supervisor consent create/respond/revoke

remediation.options: Log AuditEvent in create, consent_response, and destroy actions.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: create logs at supervisor_relationships_controller.rb:52, consent_response at :101, destroy at :135. approve/deny route through consent_response.

findings.title: Worker service missing encryption keys in render.yaml

remediation.options: Add SECRET_KEY_BASE, SECURE_ENCRYPTION_KEY, SECURE_NONCE_KEY, COOKIE_KEY to the worker envVars.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: LingoLinq-AAC-Worker (render.yaml:55) now declares all four keys with generateValue (render.yaml:84-91). Note: prod is migrating to GCP Cloud Run with Secret Manager; render.yaml remains the live config until cutover.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /api/v1/status exposed internal queue/db state

remediation.options: Gate internal diagnostics behind @api_user; return {active: true} to unauthenticated callers.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: status action returns {active: true} for unauthenticated callers (session_controller.rb:948); queue/db introspection runs only when @api_user present (:952-967).

findings.title: Consent endpoints absent from Rack::Attack protected_paths

remediation.options: Add supervisor_relationships/.*/consent (and the consent_response/approve/deny paths) to protected_paths so they fall under the 10-req/3s limit.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: protected_paths (throttling.rb:18-21) contains no consent path; consent endpoints are unauthenticated and fall under the 150-req/3s general limit.

findings.title: License.metadata / external_reference stored unencrypted

remediation.options: Add secure_serialize :metadata to License, consistent with Organization/User sensitive-field handling.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: License includes only GlobalId; no secure_serialize declared. metadata text + external_reference string remain plaintext.

findings.title: License not handled in transfer_user_content (orphaned seats on merge)

remediation.options: Add License.where(user_id: source.id).update_all(user_id: target.id) to transfer_user_content.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: transfer_user_content transfers NfcTag/UserIntegration/UserGoal/UserBadge/Webhook/UserBoardConnection/UserLink/ButtonSound/ButtonImage/UserVideo but not License (flusher.rb:156-190). License IS handled in flush_user_content (see P0-2), only the transfer path is missing it.

findings.title: Sensitive new routes (claim_user) under general throttle only

remediation.options: Add api/v1/organizations/.+/claim_user to protected_paths.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: claim_user not present in protected_paths. Shares the throttling.rb anchor with P1-1/P2-6; remediate together.

findings.title: consent_response accepts token/decision from multiple parameter keys

remediation.options: Standardize to a single token key and a single decision key; or Scot accepts the risk given token_valid? + expiry guards now present.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: multi-key acceptance persists (line 86), though surrounding flow is more defensive (token_valid?, expiry). Candidate for accepted-risk pending Scot.

findings.title: forgot_password leaks account existence via response shape and users count

remediation.options: Return a uniform {email_sent: true} regardless of existence; drop the users count.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: forgot_password (users_controller.rb:692) returns users: users.length on success (:705/:708) and a 400 with users: 0 (:714), enabling enumeration.

findings.title: Password changes (incl. admin resets) generate no AuditEvent

remediation.options: Add AuditEvent.log_command/create! in the password-change path (notify_of_changes / @password_changed branch).

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: notify_of_changes (user.rb:2255) only schedules a password_changed mailer (:2257); no AuditEvent. AuditEvent is used elsewhere in user.rb (e.g. :540, :581) but not for password changes.

findings.title: SNS transcoding callbacks accepted without signature verification

remediation.options: Apply Aws::SNS::MessageVerifier to the transcoding callback path as already done for the SMS-inbound path.

findings.notes: Reduced-scope 2026-06-12: SMS-inbound path now verifies via Aws::SNS::MessageVerifier.authentic? (callbacks_controller.rb:37-38), but the general transcoding TODO at :8 remains. Originally scoped to all SNS callbacks.

findings.title: start_code_lookup uses a brute-forceable 5-char verification hash

remediation.options: Increase the verification-hash length to at least 16 chars; this unauthenticated endpoint leaks org/supervisor names.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: hash truncated to [0, 5] of SHA512 (organizations_controller.rb:128).

findings.title: Redis connections without TLS; shared across environments

remediation.options: Use TLS (rediss) and per-environment instances. Being overtaken by the GCP Memorystore migration (private VPC egress); reconcile rather than fix twice.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: Redis.new without ssl options (resque.rb:23,26,60,110). NOTE: prod Redis is moving to GCP Memorystore over private VPC (project_render_cloud_migration Phase 3); resolution should land with that cutover.

findings.title: Webhook callback URL validation accepts plaintext http://

remediation.options: Require https:// in the callback URL validation regex.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: regex /^http/ matches both http and https (webhook.rb:42).

findings.title: Static cache_token='abc' never rotates (stale permission cache)

remediation.options: Derive cache_token from an env var or the deploy commit SHA.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: literal 'abc' (resque.rb:29). Low real-world impact but unchanged.

findings.title: No explicit HSTS ssl_options (subdomains/preload)

remediation.options: Add config.ssl_options = { hsts: { subdomains: true, preload: true, expires_in: 1.year } }.

findings.notes: Partially mitigated 2026-06-12: force_ssl=true already emits a default HSTS header (max-age 1yr) but without subdomains/preload (production.rb:62). Severity effectively lower than the April P1; left high pending Scot's call.

findings.title: Legacy s3 gem (0.3.29) in production

remediation.options: None needed.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: no legacy s3 gem in Gemfile/Gemfile.lock; aws-sdk-s3 1.219.0 is the only S3 client (Gemfile:59). Finding obsolete.

findings.notes: Superseded: the finding's premise (legacy gem present) is false in current code.

findings.title: flush_leftovers is unimplemented (orphan records accumulate)

remediation.options: Implement incrementally; prioritize stale images (item 1) and orphaned versions (item 7).

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: method body is TODO comments only (flusher.rb:48-62).

findings.title: params.permit! bypasses Strong Parameters

remediation.options: Migrate call sites to explicit permit(:fields) in new code; do not refactor working code wholesale (April guidance).

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: the guarded idiom `X.permit! if X.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)` remains widespread (~43 call sites across API controllers; the April '40+ occurrences' characterization still holds and is NOT reduced). Rated low on impact, not prevalence: models do their own input filtering so this is a defense-in-depth gap, and application_controller.rb:91 now carries an explicit do-not-globally-permit note. Anchored at organizations_controller.rb:866 as one representative unguarded `.permit!.to_h`.

findings.title: License model lacks Processable concern

remediation.options: Evaluate whether Processable's uniqueness enforcement fits License; or Scot accepts as by-design.

findings.notes: Verified 2026-06-12: License includes only GlobalId. Plausibly by-design (licensing is not draft/published content); candidate for accepted-risk pending Scot.

findings.title: external_reference exposed in license JSON without permission check

remediation.options: Only include external_reference for users with manage permission on the org.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: external_reference (PO number / Stripe id) always serialized (json_api/license.rb:16).

findings.title: DataPolicyEnforcer retention only purges session log sessions

remediation.options: Extend retention enforcement to other data types referenced in org data policies (boards, images, notes).

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: enforce_retention! filters LogSession to log_type 'session' only (data_policy_enforcer.rb:13-14).

findings.title: Registration/2fa/SAML endpoints under general throttle only

remediation.options: Add POST api/v1/users, confirm_registration, 2fa, saml/consume to protected_paths or a stricter group.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: none of these paths present in protected_paths (throttling.rb:18-21). Shares anchor with P1-1/P1-4.

findings.title: User creation (incl. org start codes) generates no AuditEvent

remediation.options: Add AuditEvent in the create action for school-context provisioning.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: create (users_controller.rb:244) calls User.process_new and renders without an AuditEvent.

findings.title: protected_image accepts user_token via URL parameter

remediation.options: Accept the token via Authorization header or short-lived signed URLs; URL params leak to logs/history/Referer.

findings.notes: Verified still open 2026-06-12: protected_image (users_controller.rb:869) reads params['user_token'] (:871).

findings.title: user_name exposed for expired licenses during expiration window

remediation.options: Gate user_name on user_id presence (release_user! nullifies user_id).

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12: user_id/user_name serialized only when license.user_id is present (json_api/license.rb:17-19); release_user! nullifies user_id, so an expired/released license exposes no user_name.

findings.title: S3 buckets public-read on * (legacy ACL)

remediation.options: Object Ownership BucketOwnerEnforced disables ACLs; app acl: public-read requests are silently ignored.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Verified 2026-06-12 (doc-level): INFRASTRUCTURE.md:101 records ACLs disabled via BucketOwnerEnforced; the app's acl: public-read is a no-op. Bucket-policy posture should still be confirmed in the GCP/AWS infra-audit refresh.

findings.notes: Doc-level closure; recommend a live AWS bucket-policy spot-check during the next infra-audit run.

findings.title: BAA with AWS (S3/SES/Transcoder/SNS) for HIPAA

remediation.options: Execute AWS hybrid BAA via AWS Artifact.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Closed 2026-06-08: AWS hybrid BAA signed via AWS Artifact, covering S3/SES/Transcoder/SNS (docs/legal/AWS_BAA_ACCEPTED.md; project_render_cloud_migration Phase 1). Attestation = external legal artifact, not code.

findings.notes: Non-code finding; evidence is an executed legal agreement, validated by attestation not citation-check.

findings.title: BAA with Render (Postgres/Redis hosting) for FERPA/HIPAA

remediation.options: None on Render.

closureEvidence.verifierNote: Superseded 2026-06-12: prod is migrating off Render to GCP Cloud Run; Google org-wide BAA accepted 2026-06-08. The Render hosting BAA is no longer the compliance path for PHI. Render stays as a PHI-free dev/staging + rollback surface (project_render_cloud_migration).

findings.notes: Render prod remains the live rollback path until GCP cutover, but carries no PHI under the migration plan.
